title: Stop waiting for a better time
summary: Remembrance becomes true when it stops waiting for a better hour. Let contentment prove your discipline.
lifeApplication: At the moment you say 'later,' catch it in the throat and interrupt it. Take the Name before the next task teaches you to postpone again.

source.shortMeaning: Remembrance becomes true when it stops waiting for a better hour.
source.lifeApplication: When you say 'later,' take one breath and remember now.
